description: This file implements a common fault handler for ARM Cortex-M processors within the Zephyr RTOS, including fault diagnosis, secure/non-secure handling, and fault-specific dump functions.

methods.name: fault_show
methods.description: Displays short fault information based on fault level.

methods.name: memory_fault_recoverable
methods.description: Determines if a memory fault is recoverable based on the fault address and context.

methods.name: bus_fault
methods.description: Handles and reports bus faults, including address and type.

methods.name: usage_fault
methods.description: Handles and reports usage faults, such as undefined instructions or illegal states.

methods.name: secure_fault
methods.description: Handles secure state faults, reporting specific secure fault reasons.

methods.name: debug_monitor
methods.description: Handles debug monitor exceptions and determines recoverability.

methods.name: z_arm_is_synchronous_svc
methods.description: Checks if the fault was caused by a synchronous SVC instruction.

methods.name: z_arm_is_pc_valid
methods.description: Validates if a program counter value is within known valid regions.

methods.name: hard_fault
methods.description: Handles hard faults, including escalation and specific fault reasons.

methods.name: fault_handle
methods.description: Main dispatcher for fault handling based on fault type.

methods.name: secure_stack_dump
methods.description: Dumps secure stack information during fault analysis.

methods.name: get_esf
methods.description: Retrieves the exception stack frame considering security state and exception return value.

methods.name: z_arm_fault
methods.description: Main fault handler invoked on fatal errors, performs fault diagnosis, and triggers system fatal error handling.

methods.name: z_arm_fault_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware fault handling features, such as division by zero trap and unaligned access trap.
